#  Nonfiltered bams
# make sample information and load read data for diffbind
## spikein normalisation manually implemented when dba.counts is created
```{r}
rm(list=ls())
working_dir <- "/path/to/project"

# bam files directory
hg38_bamReads_dir <-  file.path(paste(working_dir,"/results/bam_files/final_bams/hg38",sep=""), list.files(path = paste(working_dir,"/results/bam_files/final_bams/hg38",sep=""), pattern = "_OTHER_hg38_nodm6_chrmrm_blrm_duprm_unmappedrm_multimaprm.bam$"))


# Peaks directory
Peaks_dir_macs2_with_no_input <-file.path(paste(working_dir,"/results/macs2/macs2_q0.01/with_no_neg_control/narrowPeak",sep=""),list.files(path = paste(working_dir,"/results/macs2/macs2_q0.01/with_no_neg_control/narrowPeak",sep=""), pattern = "*narrowPeak$"))


# check peaks and bam samples are in the same order
peaks_names <- Peaks_dir_macs2_with_no_input %>% gsub("_peaks.narrowPeak","",.) %>% gsub("/path/to/project/results/macs2/macs2_q0.01/with_no_neg_control/narrowPeak/","",.)
bam_names <- hg38_bamReads_dir %>% gsub("/path/to/project/results/bam_files/final_bams/hg38/","",.) %>% gsub("_Homo_sapiens_OTHER_hg38_nodm6_chrmrm_blrm_duprm_unmappedrm_multimaprm.bam","",.)
table(peaks_names == bam_names)

# SampleID
SampleID <- bam_names

list.files(path = paste(working_dir,"/results/bam_files/final_bams/hg38",sep=""),  pattern = "_chrmrm_blrm_duprm_unmappedrm_multimaprm.bam$") %>% 
  gsub("_chrmrm_blrm_duprm_unmappedrm_multimaprm.bam", "", .)

SampleID <- SampleID %>% gsub("0_6", "0.6",.)
SampleID <- SampleID %>% gsub("2_5", "2.5",.)
SampleID <- SampleID %>% gsub("7_5", "7.5",.)
SampleID <- SampleID %>% gsub("_Homo_sapiens_OTHER_hg38_nodm6", "",.)
SampleID <- SampleID %>% gsub("_PS_HsDm_CTCF", "",.)
SampleID <- SampleID %>% gsub("_Cut_and_Run", "",.)
SampleID <- SampleID %>% gsub("0602_", "",.)
SampleID <- SampleID %>% gsub("_GSM", "-GSM",.)

sample_information <- data.frame(SampleID = SampleID, 
                                 bamReads = hg38_bamReads_dir,
                                 Peaks = Peaks_dir_macs2_with_no_input)


#narrow because looking at transcription factors. 
sample_information$PeakCaller <- "narrow"
# generate the 3 columns (cell line, treatment, replicate number) from the temp column
sample_information <- sample_information %>% separate(SampleID, into = c( "Antibody", "Condition"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE)
sample_information$CellLine <- "K562"
sample_information$SampleID <- paste(sample_information$Antibody,sample_information$Condition,sep="_")

```


# Cleaning and reshaping bam count reads for spike-in normalisation

```{r}
summary_bam_counts <- read_tsv(paste(working_dir,"/results/summary_hg38_dm6_bam_counts.txt",sep=""))

col_names <- names(summary_bam_counts) %>% strsplit(split=" ") %>% unlist()
summary_bam_counts <- separate(summary_bam_counts,1,into=col_names,sep=" ")

SampleID <- summary_bam_counts$basename %>% gsub("0_6", "0.6",.)
SampleID <- SampleID %>% gsub("2_5", "2.5",.)
SampleID <- SampleID %>% gsub("7_5", "7.5",.)
SampleID <- SampleID %>% gsub("_Homo_sapiens_OTHER", "",.)
SampleID <- SampleID %>% gsub("_PS_HsDm_CTCF", "",.)
SampleID <- SampleID %>% gsub("_Cut_and_Run", "",.)
SampleID <- SampleID %>% gsub("0602_", "",.)
SampleID <- SampleID %>% gsub("_GSM", "-GSM",.)

summary_bam_counts$basename <- SampleID

summary_bam_counts <- summary_bam_counts %>% separate(basename, into = c( "Antibody", "Condition"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE)
summary_bam_counts[,grepl("bam_count",colnames(summary_bam_counts))] <- lapply(summary_bam_counts[,grepl("bam_count",colnames(summary_bam_counts))], as.numeric)
summary_bam_counts$dm6_reads_norm_scale <- summary_bam_counts$dm6_intermediate_bam_counts/mean(summary_bam_counts$dm6_intermediate_bam_counts)


sample_information <- full_join(sample_information,summary_bam_counts)
sample_information$lib_size_normaliser_calc <- sample_information$hg38_final_bam_counts/mean(sample_information$hg38_final_bam_counts)
```


# removing unwanted samples
```{r}
# removing "disrupted" sample
sample_information <- sample_information[!grepl("disrupted",sample_information$SampleID),]
# removing samples with low alignment
sample_information <- sample_information[!grepl("5s",sample_information$SampleID),]


```



```{r}
nruns = 30
```

```{r}
rand_combos_A <- data.frame(matrix(nrow=nruns,ncol=6))
names(rand_combos_A) <- c("A1","A2","A3","B1","B2","B3")
sample_information_randn = list()

set.seed(3)
for (nrun in 1:nruns){
  rand_combos_A[nrun,1:6] <- t(sample(sample_information %>% nrow(),6) %>% as.vector())
  sample_information_randn[[nrun]] <- sample_information[rand_combos_A[nrun,] %>% as.numeric(),]
  sample_information_randn[[nrun]]$Factor <- c("A","A","A","B","B","B")
  sample_information_randn[[nrun]]$Replicate <- c(1,2,3,1,2,3)

}


```



# Getting greenlist norm factors within ea. comparison

```{r}

input = "path/to/project/R_analysis_final/01.Greenlist_norm_calcs/glist_quant.tsv"
counts = read.delim(file = input,header=T,row.names = 1,check.names = F)
colnames(counts) <- paste0("path/to/project/results/bam_files/final_bams/hg38/",colnames(counts),".bam")


for(j in 1:nrun){
#j=2
counts_nrun <- counts[,match(sample_information_randn[[j]]$bamReads,colnames(counts))]
sf = estimateSizeFactorsForMatrix(counts_nrun)
sf = as.data.frame(sf)
sf$greenlist_normalizer = (1/sf$sf)
sf$bamReads <- rownames(sf)

sample_information_randn[[j]] <- full_join(sample_information_randn[[j]],sf)
#  rm(sf)
  
}

```


```{r, eval=FALSE}
rand_comb_rec <- c()
for (i in 1:nruns){

  rand_comb_rec[i] <-   paste(paste(sample_information_randn[[i]]$Condition[sample_information_randn[[i]]$Factor=="B"],collapse = ","),paste(sample_information_randn[[i]]$Condition[sample_information_randn[[i]]$Factor=="A"],collapse = ","),sep="vs") %>% gsub("million","mill",.)
  
}


comparison_table <- data_frame(runs = 1:nrun, comparison = rand_comb_rec %>% gsub("vs"," vs ",. ) %>% gsub(",", ", ",.))
write.csv(comparison_table, file = "path/to/project/R_analysis_final/02.Sample_information/data/list_of_comps.csv")

```
